offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes prescription drugs for gastrointestinal disorders, mainly through licensing partners. Sells to patients through prescriptions written by physicians and filled by pharmacies, and earns royalties on partner sales.

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with irritable bowel syndrome or chronic constipation; B2B: pharmacies, wholesalers and health plans that pay for prescriptions

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties and collaboration payments from partners selling gastrointestinal drugs

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns drug rights and licenses commercial sales to partners, who sell to pharmacies and wholesalers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, with partners selling in Europe, Japan and China

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on gastrointestinal disorders with a small product portfolio

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: licensed pharmaceutical companies that market and sell the drugs; third-party retail: retail and specialty pharmacies that dispense prescriptions

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drugs need FDA approval and are governed by FDA and other national drug regulators

notes: Product rights and partner arrangements may have changed; revenue structure and pipeline status are uncertain.
